title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-ergonomics-parity-v1.188.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Unify SDK behavior across Python, TypeScript, and Go: consolidate auth hooks and retry logic, add streaming API parity and ergonomics improvements, bump client package versions to v1.188.0, and update changelogs and docs. This PR standardizes token refresh behavior (single RefreshAuth interface across SDKs), centralizes retry/backoff policy configuration, harmonizes streaming generator ergonomics (consistent async/pull/push semantics), fixes parity issues identified in cross-language integration tests, and includes compatibility shims for older client usages. Includes test updates, CI stability fixes for flaky streaming tests, and release notes. See linked Linear tasks ENG-2345 and PM-987 for product requirements. Checklist: 1) unify auth interfaces across SDKs; 2) implement shared retry/backoff config; 3) streaming API parity and ergonomic alias methods; 4) version bumps and changelog entries; 5) run full interop matrix and e2e streaming tests.
